title: Part Fifteen: Settled, Contested and Open

sections.brief: What the record settles about Israel and Iran 1948-2026 (alliance and arms trade; the Jewish community's two facts; both nuclear records; the prediction test; Iran's own record; the wars' tolls by method), and what is contested with both sides (fatwa, 2003 fax, 2005 translation, motives for 2018 and 2025-26, damage assessments, who pushed 2026). Figures: compare (Settled / Contested / Open); time (1948-2026 arc)

What remains open as of October 2026 (stockpile, NPT, the war's end, succession); verdicts on Ron's three theses (false alarms; Iran does not want war with the US; the US was dragged in), each supported / not supported / argument; the 'paradox' of Iran's Jews as the record has it. Figure: compare (three theses)
